motivation: Prior raster topology gate is frozen as TOPOLOGY_EXTRACTION_UNSTABLE because DED component count changes 121->123 from 300 to 600 dpi. Post-failure localization showed the same two extra tiny components in both EPS representations, motivating an independent vector-stroke extractor rather than threshold retuning. Raw Cairo EPS retains graph geometry as m/l/c/S path primitives.
path_filter: stroked subpaths with exactly one moveto plus one lineto-or-curveto command and both endpoints inside the frozen ROI

expected_abstract_multigraphs.DED: three endpoint clusters; edge multiplicities 4 from upper boundary cluster to central cluster and 4 from lower boundary cluster to central cluster
expected_abstract_multigraphs.DLD1: four endpoint clusters; multiplicities 4 upper-to-central1, 1 central1-to-central2, 4 lower-to-central2

frozen_gate: After identifying the unique DLD1 degree-5 central pair joined by the single non-bundle edge, contracting that edge must yield a multigraph isomorphic to the extracted DED graph, preserving the two multiplicity-4 boundary bundles.
promotion_if_pass: Classify only as DED_DLD1_VERTEX_GRAPH_CONTRACTION_SOURCE_VERIFIED. It permits a separate source-semantic audit asking whether the contracted stroke is the DLD internal-face strand and whether j_f=0 implements the strict trivial extension. It does not itself prove a V/E/F subfoam embedding or authorize an amplitude identity.
claim_locks: The old raster TOPOLOGY_EXTRACTION_UNSTABLE result remains preserved.
No ROI, clustering tolerance, path filter, or multiplicity expectation may be changed after seeing the GitHub result.
No bridge/refinement/amplitude credit from this gate alone.
